body_markdown:
**VICTOR, N.Y.** – Broadstone Net Lease, Inc. (NYSE: BNL) (“BNL”, the “Company”, “we”, “our”, or “us”), announced today that we have secured the land and started construction on two additional build-to-suit developments for Hobby Lobby and Academy Sports, both of which were directly sourced, off-market transactions, and are expected to deliver in the second quarter of 2027.


To download a PDF of the full press release,[click here](https://broadstone.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/August-2026-Press-Release-Manor-TX.pdf) .
